name: flatten uses depth-first order and dictionary insertion order
input: nested dictionaries, lists, tuples, and empty containers
test:
structure = {'west': [3, 5], 'east': {'items': [{'id': 7}], 'end': 9}}
assert flatten(structure) == [3, 5, 7, 9]
assert flatten((2, [4, (6, 8)], {'value': 10})) == [2, 4, 6, 8, 10]
assert flatten({'items': [], 'pair': (), 'mapping': {}}) == []
assert flatten(73) == [73]
